tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: index.html mounts the React frontend via Vite's module script, importing the main JS bundle (WebTorrent streaming UI) and Tailwind stylesheet. This is where the user's browser session begins.

tour.title: Main Streaming Server
tour.description: server.cjs is the core Express.js server — it manages WebSocket WebRTC signaling for peer-to-peer video streaming, handles video rooms, publishes comments, and serves the frontend bundles. The startServer function orchestrates all routes and WebSocket events.

tour.title: WebSocket Swarm & Room Management
tour.description: The server's broadcasting functions enable real-time P2P coordination: broadcastToRoom sends events to peers in a specific video room, broadcastToAll reaches every connected client, and broadcastSwarmStats aggregates per-peer download/upload speeds and progress for the swarm dashboard.

tour.title: Atom IDE Sub-App — AI Copilot & Collaboration
tour.description: The Atom IDE clone (app/atom/) features a Gemini AI copilot for code chat and autofix, GitHub OAuth integration, and WebSocket-based collaborative editing. Its server (app/atom/server.cjs) follows the same Express + WebSocket pattern as the main server but with AI-focused routes.

tour.title: Blender 3D & FPV Drone Sub-Apps — Three.js Visualizers
tour.description: app/blender/ is a 3D modeling environment with Gemini AI command translation, real-time chat, and user presence — backed by Three.js. app/drone/ is an FPV drone flight simulator with Three.js rendering, audio (wind, crash, gate pass), and no server-side logic (purely client-side). Both demonstrate the pattern of embedding rich browser-based 3D experiences.

tour.title: n8n Workflow Automation Sub-App
tour.description: The n8n clone (app/n8n/) provides a visual workflow editor with drag-and-drop node execution, AI-powered sentiment analysis via Gemini, and real-time collaboration over WebSocket. Its server mirrors the shared Express/WebSocket + Gemini AI architecture seen across the Atom and Blender sub-apps.
